sources.text: after spending two or three days exploring the country we turned back to the bay where lay the seven ships we had seen near steilacoom
unc poked his head a little farther out and put his hand behind his ear
and the browns and greys were so richly and nobly gilded by splashes of sunlight
savareen had left the toll gate and proceeded northward not more than two or three minutes before lapierre
